title: 第21章 自取其辱第22章 转变
slug: 修真废柴我的系统有点猛
lines: 那中年执事则转向姚德龙，眼中闪过一丝惊讶。
能完全无视金丹修士的威压和杀机，这枯槁老头的心性倒是罕见。
他也没废话，直接从柜台深处取出一口通体黝黑、造型古朴、三足两耳、炉身铭刻着复杂玄奥火焰符文的丹炉。
炉盖微启，一股精纯而灼热的气息便扑面而来！
“地火蕴灵炉，极品灵器丹炉。
内蕴一缕地火精魄，可助控火凝丹，提升成丹率，尤其对火属性丹药有奇效。
售价：四十枚中品灵石。”
姚德龙眼睛一亮。
好东西！
这炉子比他那个破黑炉不知强了多少倍！
“老东西你买得起吗？”
武丰语气充满了恶意的快感。
他强行压下怒火后，此刻见姚德龙竟敢询问极品灵器丹炉，
立即找到了新的发泄口和羞辱点。
“四十枚中品灵石！
你知道那是多少吗？”
他环视四周，声音陡然拔高，带着煽动性的嘲弄；
“让本师兄帮你算算！
一块中品灵石，抵一百下品灵石！
四十块，就是四千块下品灵石！”
“普通外门弟子，每月俸禄不过二十块下品灵石！
内门弟子才五十块！
核心弟子一百块！
亲传弟子才堪堪3块中品灵石！”
武丰每说一句，周围弟子的哄笑声就更大一分，
无数鄙夷、幸灾乐祸的目光如同针尖般刺向姚德龙。
“四千块！
你不吃不喝，外门弟子得攒上二百个月！
内门弟子也要攒上8个月！
就算你是亲传——哦，对了！”
武丰故作恍然大悟状，夸张地一拍脑门，
“你只是个落霞峰的废物大师兄，连核心弟子都不是！
怕是连二十块下品灵石的月俸都拿不全吧？”
“哈哈哈！”
“听见没？四千块下品灵石！”
“这老东西怕是把棺材本都卖了也凑不够一个零头！”
“真是笑死人了！
赶紧滚吧，别在这丢人现眼了！”
“就是！
也不撒泡尿照照自己？还极品灵器丹炉？买个烧火炉还差不多！”
哄笑声、嘲讽声、鄙夷声如同潮水般将姚德龙淹没。
武丰抱着胳膊，脸上满是报复性的快意，他要看着这老东西在所有人面前狼狈不堪，彻底沦为笑柄！
content_en:
The middle-aged deacon turned to Yao Delong, with a hint of surprise in his eyes.
It is rare for this haggard old man's character to be able to completely ignore the pressure and murderous intentions of the Golden Core cultivator.
He didn't waste any time and directly took out a dark-colored pill furnace with a simple shape, three legs and two ears, and complex mysterious flame runes engraved on the furnace body from the depths of the counter.
The furnace lid was slightly opened, and a pure and hot breath came to my face!
"The Earth Fire Spiritual Furnace is the ultimate spiritual weapon and alchemy furnace.
It contains a ray of earth fire essence, which can help control fire-condensing elixirs and increase the rate of elixir formation. It is especially effective for fire-attribute elixirs.
Price: Forty mid-grade spiritual stones. "
Yao Delong's eyes lit up.
nice one!
This furnace is countless times more powerful than his broken black furnace!
"Can you afford old stuff?"
Takefeng's tone was full of malicious pleasure.
After he suppressed his anger forcibly, he saw that Yao Delong dared to ask about the top-quality spiritual weapon Dan Furnace.
A new outlet and point of humiliation was immediately found.
“Forty middle-grade spiritual stones!
Do you know how much that is? "
He looked around, his voice suddenly rising with inflammatory mockery;
"Let me, senior fellow apprentice, help you do the math!
One middle-grade spiritual stone is worth a hundred low-grade spiritual stones!
Forty yuan is four thousand low-grade spiritual stones! "
"The monthly salary of an ordinary outer disciple is only twenty low-grade spiritual stones!
Inner disciples only have fifty yuan!
One hundred yuan for core disciples!
A direct disciple can only afford three middle-grade spiritual stones! "
Every time Wu Feng said something, the laughter from the surrounding disciples got louder.
Countless scornful and gloating glances pierced Yao Delong like needlepoints.
“Four thousand dollars!
If you don't eat or drink, the outer disciples will have to save for two hundred months!
Inner disciples also have to save for 8 months!
Even if you are a direct descendant—oh, that’s right! "
Wu Feng pretended to be suddenly enlightened and slapped his forehead exaggeratedly.
"You are just a useless senior brother from Luoxia Peak, not even a core disciple!
I'm afraid that I can't even get the monthly salary of twenty low-grade spiritual stones, right? "
"Hahaha!"
"Did you hear that? Four thousand low-grade spiritual stones!"
"I'm afraid this old guy won't be able to get even a cent even if he sells all the coffins!"
“It’s so funny!
Go away now, don't be embarrassed here! "
"That's right!
Why don't you take a pee and take a picture of yourself? And the best spiritual weapon pill furnace? It’s almost as good as buying a stove! "
Yao Delong was drowned by laughter, ridicule, and contempt like a tide.
Wu Feng crossed his arms, his face full of vindictive pleasure. He wanted to see this old guy embarrassed in front of everyone and completely reduced to a laughing stock!
